tasks.label: CMake: Build Motor Tuner Release
tasks.detail: Build the custom motor-tuner target with the Release preset and GNU STM32 14.3.1+st.2.

tasks.label: Flash Motor Tuner via ST-LINK
tasks.detail: Flash and verify the Release tuner ELF via ST-LINK/SWD, then reset. STM32CubeProgrammer is invoked by absolute path, not PATH.

tasks.label: Build + Flash Motor Tuner (Release)
tasks.detail: Build Release, then flash and reset the tuner via ST-LINK.
